newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CMN okays 2nd branch for Argentine bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CMN okays 2nd branch for Argentine bank.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council has recommended that Argentine bank Banco de la Provincia de Buenos Aires be allowed to open a second branch in Brazil, an official said.

The bank, which is controlled by the province of Buenos Aires, already has a branch in the city of Sao Paulo but plans to open a second in Curitiba, capital of Parana state, Central Bank Norms Director Alkimar Moura said.
The CMN was in favor of authorizing the new branch given that Argentina belonged to the four-nation South American customs union of which Brazil is also a member.
The CMN's recommendation will be sent to President Fernando Henrique Cardoso who has the power to issue decrees authorizing foreign banks to operate in Brazil.
